title: Thread-safe TTL cache (actor)
summary: Build a generic in-memory cache with per-entry expiry and a size limit, safe to use from many tasks.
approach: Actor-isolated dictionary of (value, expiry); evict expired entries on read; evict the oldest insertion when over capacity. Inject a clock for tests.
complexity: O(1) average get/set; O(n) occasional eviction
body: Discuss: actor vs `Mutex` (sync callers?), memory pressure (NSCache), LRU vs FIFO eviction, testing time with an injected `Clock`.
